blurb: Enota is a world class unique conservation facility and retreat center that is nestled in the mountains of North Georgia and is surrounded by the Chattahoochee National Forest. The property, which is known to be sacred to the Native Americans and their descendants that once called the area home, eventually became Camp Pioneer in the 1940s and was run by the Atlanta YMCA.
